S01: High above the world, in the palace of the sky, it all began. There lived the god Nyame.
S02: His bride bore two children, beautiful as a dream.
S03: One child was made entirely of gold, the other — of silver.
S04: But one servant girl could not bear another's happiness.
S05: Envy tightened her heart, and in the dark she devised an evil deed.
S06: In the middle of the night, she took the children from their cradles and carried them away.
S07: Through the dark forest, deeper and deeper, she carried them to be left behind.
S08: Beneath a great tree she laid them among the leaves and departed.
S09: And in their cradles she left two hideous toads.
S10: When the father came to see his children, only toads awaited him.
S11: Instead of childish laughter, he heard only croaking.
S12: In his wrath, Nyame judged his own wife and cast her out of the sky.
S13: Far away, in the forest, lived a kind-hearted hunter.
S14: One morning, something sweet reached his ear.
S15: That voice led him through the ferns and the thickets.
S16: And beneath the great tree, among the leaves, he found two shining children.
S18: Hunter: "I will take you home with me!"
S19: He loved them as truly his own sons, and the days passed happily.
S20: Every day he bathed them in warm water, and then a wonder occurred.
S21: From the golden child, golden dust fell into the water.
S22: And from the silver one — silver dust, like snow from moonlight.
S23: The hunter carefully gathered that precious dust.
S24: With that dust he bought food and clothing for them all.
S25: Little by little, he had enough dust for a whole great farm.
S26: But one day, he heard a tale of the golden and silver twins.
S27: A tale of children who vanished from the palace of Nyame.
S28: Then he understood: these children belong to their true father.
S29: Hunter: "I will return you to your true father."
S30: And so they set out on the long road to the heavenly palace.
S31: On the horizon awaited the palace of Nyame, wrapped in storm.
S32: The hunter arrived before the gates of heaven with the children.
S33: Silence fell in the throne hall.
S34: Then the eyes of Nyame beheld a radiance he knew.
S35: With arms spread wide, the god descended to them in joy.
S36: Nyame: "My children! You have come home!"
S37: Nyame called his bride to return, and she came.
S38: The mother wept with happiness, holding the children tight.
S39: The whole family was finally together.
S40: Then the gaze of Nyame turned toward the servant girl.
S41: She trembled, for her evil deed had been discovered.
S42: Nyame raised his hand and divine light flashed.
S43: That light wrapped around the servant girl and a wonder began.
S44: Where the wicked one had stood, now clucked a hen.
S45: The children watched the hen in peace, and the court fell silent.
S46: Nyame: "I reward you for your good heart."
S47: And before the hunter appeared riches: gold, precious stones and silk.
S48: And in the golden sunset, the palace shone with happiness and peace.
